quarterly_data.quarter: WUS Printed Circuit half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-26-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2026 half-year report: H1 revenue RMB 13,689,427,504, up 61.17% year over year; net profit attributable RMB 2,923,361,746, up 73.72% (excluding non-recurring items RMB 2,794,525,941, up 70.00%). PCB business revenue RMB 12,994,479,182, up 59.39%, with PCB gross margin rising to 40.52% (up 4.06 percentage points) on product mix; PCB products of 32 layers and above grew about 190.83%. Data-communications PCB gross margin was 43.26%. Smart automotive PCB revenue RMB 1,438,141,833, up 1.11%, with gross margin 18.97%, down 6.22 points as raw-material costs rose faster than price increases could pass through; within it, automotive intelligence and electrification about RMB 5.89 hundred million (up about 12.18%) and automotive safety and other about RMB 8.50 hundred million. Revenue exported directly to the United States was no more than 3%. Operating cash flow fell 45.14% to RMB 1,150,686,191 as full order books raised raw-material purchases.

quarterly_data.quarter: WUS Printed Circuit half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-26-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2026 half-year report: at the Thailand base, more than 90% of the data-communications division's overseas customers have completed certification and the original capacity is essentially fully utilized; PCBs of under 30 layers are in volume production for 400G switches, AI servers and other data-communications uses, and sampling of 800G switch products has started. Equipment for a targeted capacity upgrade moved in for installation and commissioning during Q2 2026 and will be released progressively. The Thailand subsidiary's Q2 2026 revenue was about RMB 3.75 hundred million with net profit of about RMB 0.43 hundred million; for H1 it had revenue of RMB 671,153,946 and a net loss of RMB 17,528,103.
quarterly_data.figure: >90% of overseas data-com customers certified; original capacity essentially full; Q2 2026 Thailand revenue ~RMB 3.75 hundred million, net profit ~RMB 0.43 hundred million

quarterly_data.quarter: WUS Printed Circuit half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-26-2026)

quarterly_data.quarter: WUS Printed Circuit half-year report: 2026 Half-Year Report (08-26-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: 2026 half-year report: the company says commodity price surges in H1 2026 pushed related raw-material prices up, and some high-end raw materials faced phased capacity limits and tight supply; it joins end customers' development very early to test new materials and lock in priority allocation, holds strategic safety stock of key materials and is speeding diversified and localized qualification.
